label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL01
en: Your lightning counterattack blunted the Soviet invasion.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL01
en: You barely succeeded in holding back the Soviet advance.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL02
en: Your tank blitz stunned the Soviets, ending the battle in a few short hours.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL02
en: Your grinding assault cost hundreds of lives but liberated the Air Force Academy.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL03
en: The President was rescued long before the Soviets could discover any important military secrets.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL03
en: The President was rescued, though many military secrets were compromised.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL04
en: The tragic loss of Chicago, however devastating, doesn't compare to the loss of our whole nation. Your quick destruction of the Psychic Amplifier meant that the Soviets never had time to fully test its power.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL04
en: The Psychic Amplifier was destroyed, but not before the Soviets gained valuable test data about it's effects. In spite of the tragic loss of Chicago, however, you've saved our entire nation from falling under the influence of the Soviets' most powerful psychic weapon.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL05
en: Soviet commanders are still analyzing your attack, trying to discover the secrets of your advanced covert strategies.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL05
en: The missiles have been destroyed. Other Soviet missiles have been moved deep inside the USSR.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL06
en: The precision with which you destroyed the Soviet forces and liberated Washington DC is one for the record books.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL06
en: Washington DC has been saved, but at a terrible price in men and materials.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL07
en: You defended Pearl Harbor with such ferocity that the Pacific is ours.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL07
en: Pearl Harbor has been saved, but the Hawaiian islands have been devestated by the Soviet onslaught.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL08
en: You saved Saint Louis before her citizens could come to any harm.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL08
en: Saint Louis was saved, but thousands of American citizens were permanently turned to the Soviet cause.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL09
en: Soviet Soldiers have nicknamed you "The Ghost" for your skills at stealthy destruction.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL09
en: Thanks to you, our technology has been recovered.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL10
en: Impressed by your efficiency, German Commanders have asked you to train their officers in strategy and command.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL10
en: The Black Forest lab has been saved, Einstein's work can continue.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL11
en: Russian commanders fear your command more than whole Allied divisions. If one man can make a difference, you are that man.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL11
en: The Chronosphere is built. Thanks to your tireless effort, the Allies are ready for one final push to victory.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgALL12
en: Your legendary command skills will go down in history. You are one of the greatest generals of all time.

label: GUI:OverParMsgALL12
en: Romanov is captured, the war is won. Victory is yours.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov01
en: The Pentagon was crushed so quickly that many important American generals were captured by our victorious soldiers, crippling their armed forces.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov01
en: Thanks to you, the Pentagon has been destroyed and the American military has been thrown into chaos.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov02
en: The American fleet and Naval base were destroyed so quickly that your soldiers were able to capture several American officers.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov02
en: The American fleet was destroyed. While Soviet casualties were high, this is of no concern so long as you continue to bring victory.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov03
en: The Psychic Beacon was built so quickly that an entire American Armored division was captured by its power before they could escape.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov03
en: You have spread the power of Premier Romanov. American civilians are eagerly joining our army.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov04
en: The Korean invasion was repelled with such ferocity that some members of their government have spoken secretly to us of peace.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov04
en: In a long and bloody battle, you successfully defended mother Russia.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov05
en: The French fear your command more than they fear our tanks. In Paris you are known only as 'The Butcher'.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov05
en: You turned the Paris Tower into a weapon of terror. You have 'punished' Europe sufficiently.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov06
en: Allied Admirals now refuse to send their ships to sea, so quick was your destruction of Pearl Harbor.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov06
en: The Koreans and Americans have been successfully divided. The Pacific is ours.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov07
en: Your ruthless efficiency has earned you great respect in the Red Army and made Soviet leadership fear your popularity.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov07
en: The battle lab is safe. The Allies will not dare strike inside mother Russia again.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov08
en: Traitors beware: Your sudden and righteous attack on Washington D.C. has made your rivals fear your strategic skills.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov08
en: Vladimir has been punished for his crimes. Your victory has not gone unnoticed in this dark hour.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov09
en: World leaders tremble in fear at the mention of our psychic troops. With you in command, no one is safe.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov09
en: The President is ours to command. You will be rewarded for your zeal.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov10
en: Your strategic skills are becoming legendary. It is openly said among the men that it is you alone that will bring them victory.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov10
en: The Allies cannot hold out much longer against your heavy-handed assaults. You use the lives of your men well.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov11
en: Already your name is known to school children as the greatest general the world has ever known.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov11
en: Yuri's defenses were weak and feeble. Your tank divisions swept him aside as you have swept aside so many others.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov12
en: History will name you among the greatest commanders that has ever lived. Now the world is yours to rule.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov12
en: The Allies are beaten and the world is begging to be spared the carnage of your armed forces. Supreme power is yours alone.
